label: On the Catholic theory, the objection's conditional is false, by Reductio
meaning: Assume the objection's conditional. A first mover moved by none cannot be lacking (prima via); such a mover is what all understand as God, so by the conditional there is no evil, contradicting the evil there is. Discharging the assumption refutes the conditional. Only the double negation of the prima via conclusion is used, so no classical axiom is needed.
